name: Grotti Cheetah Classic
summary: The timeless Italian mid-engine supercar symbol of 1980s Vice City opulence, roaring with twin-turbocharged performance.
description: Nothing defines Ocean Drive cruising quite like the Grotti Cheetah Classic. Sleek pop-up headlamps, low-slung aerodynamic chassis, and vibrant red paint schemes make it one of the most sought-after exotic vehicles in Leonida.

seo.title: Grotti Cheetah Classic: Specs, Tuning & Locations
seo.description: Complete guide to the Grotti Cheetah Classic in GTA VI. Specs, customization, top speed, and where to find it on Ocean Drive.
